# Shakya.work

> Shakya — Fintech and AI product management with China know-how. Interactive AI projects, an agent office simulator, a trading lab, and a private portal for recruiters and clients.

Shakya.work is the personal site of Pranamyya Shakya (唐仲禹), an AI product manager and fintech builder based in China. The site showcases enterprise AI products, interactive demos, and a private portal for recruiters and clients.
